Subject: It Was a Pleasure Meeting You

Hi Alyssa,

It was such a pleasure speaking with you today. Thank you for taking the time to share more about your business and your goals. It's very clear you've built an impressive practice, and I appreciate how thoughtful and intentional you are about every decision you make. Rather than looking for quick fixes, you're looking for the right long-term growth partner, and I completely respect that. fileciteturn0file0

First, I wanted to properly introduce myself. I'm Bethany Gifford, Co-Founder & CEO of The Luxora Collective. I've been in the aesthetics industry since 2007, working every role from front desk and medical assisting to cosmetic sales, billing, operations, marketing, and eventually managing multi-location practices. After years of helping practices grow, I transitioned into consulting and created The Luxora Collective to help med spa owners build scalable, profitable businesses through stronger systems, better patient acquisition, increased retention, and operational excellence. My goal has never been to be another marketing agency. I truly believe sustainable growth comes from optimizing the entire business, not just generating more leads. fileciteturn0file0

One thing that really stood out to me during our conversation is that you're already doing many things well. You have excellent reviews, you're tracking KPIs, your marketing is producing a positive return, and you've built three successful locations. That's impressive. Where I believe we can provide the most value isn't by replacing what you're already doing. It's by identifying the remaining gaps that keep a very good business from becoming exceptional.

From our conversation, these are the opportunities I believe we could help strengthen:

• Standardizing systems and accountability across all three locations.
• Improving provider utilization and upselling consistency.
• Building stronger membership offerings that maximize patient lifetime value.
• Enhancing team coaching and accountability around KPIs.
• Optimizing patient retention and recurring revenue.
• Helping recruit and structure specialized roles, such as a dedicated phone closer.
• Refining the overall patient journey and experience.
• Providing strategic guidance as you continue scaling toward your goal of doubling revenue. fileciteturn0file0

You also asked several excellent questions, so I wanted to answer those more directly.

**How do we improve KPIs?**

We begin with a comprehensive Revenue Leak Audit and Market Blueprint to identify exactly where revenue is being lost. We evaluate acquisition, lead response time, consultation conversion, provider utilization, memberships, retention, recurring revenue, team performance, operational workflows, and marketing efficiency. Once those opportunities are identified, we prioritize the highest-impact improvements and implement systems that create measurable results. fileciteturn0file0

**How do we approach memberships?**

We don't believe in generic membership programs. Every membership is customized around your existing services, equipment, pricing, and patient demographics. Our objective is to maximize utilization of your existing offerings while increasing recurring monthly revenue and giving patients meaningful flexibility and value. fileciteturn0file0

**How do we train teams?**

Our coaching is customized to your practice. We provide structured training, proven scripts, objection handling, sales coaching, front desk optimization, and accountability systems. Depending on the program, we also provide ongoing coaching sessions, KPI reviews, leadership guidance, and implementation support to ensure the training actually translates into improved performance. fileciteturn0file0

**Can we help with staffing?**

Yes. Through our recruiting partnerships, we can assist with sourcing experienced injectors, estheticians, front desk staff, and dedicated phone closers when needed. fileciteturn0file0

**Can we help with practice aesthetics and patient experience?**

Absolutely. While we don't perform interior design ourselves, we've built relationships with industry specialists who focus exclusively on med spa design and patient experience. If that's an area you'd like to elevate, we can connect you with trusted partners while helping ensure every operational touchpoint matches the premium experience you're trying to create. fileciteturn0file0

I completely understand your desire to see exactly what you would receive before making any decision. That's how I would approach it as well. Attached you'll find:

- An overview of both our Done With You and Done For You programs.
- Our program agreements.
- Client testimonials and case studies.
- Additional information on our Revenue Leak Audit and methodology.

I truly enjoyed our conversation, and I look forward to connecting with you personally next week. My goal isn't to convince you to work with us. It's simply to determine whether we're the right fit for where your business is today. If we are, wonderful. If we're not, I'll gladly point you in the direction I believe will best serve you.

Thank you again for your time, Alyssa. I'm looking forward to continuing our conversation.

Warmly,

**Bethany Gifford**  
Co-Founder & CEO  
The Luxora Collective

# The Luxora Collective™ Market Blueprint

## We Don't Guess. We Assess.

Most agencies start by asking, "How much do you want to spend on ads?"

We start by asking a much better question:

**Is your market actually ready to support the growth you're looking for?**

Our proprietary Market Blueprint removes the guesswork from growth by providing a comprehensive strategic analysis of your local market before a single marketing dollar is spent.

Because the right strategy isn't built on opinions.

It's built on data.

---

## What Is the Market Blueprint?

The Market Blueprint is a comprehensive strategic assessment that analyzes your local market, competition, demographics, advertising landscape, and growth opportunities to build a roadmap for scalable, profitable growth.

Rather than assuming what will work, we identify exactly where your practice is positioned to win and where your biggest opportunities exist.

---

## What We Evaluate

### Market Opportunity
- Population size and demographics
- Household income and spending potential
- Ideal patient demographics
- Market growth trends
- Service demand

### Competitive Analysis
- Local competitors
- Market saturation
- Competitive advantages
- Positioning opportunities
- Untapped market gaps

### Digital Presence
- Website authority
- Online reputation
- Social media positioning
- Content opportunities
- Trust signals

### Advertising Landscape
- Meta advertising costs
- Google advertising costs
- Budget recommendations
- Competitive ad density
- Platform opportunities

### Patient Acquisition Opportunities
- Ideal buyer personas
- Service demand by demographic
- New patient acquisition strategies
- Geographic expansion opportunities
- Referral opportunities

### Revenue Potential
- Market size
- Service expansion opportunities
- Capacity analysis
- Growth projections
- Short- and long-term scaling opportunities

---

## What You'll Receive

Every Market Blueprint is customized specifically for your practice and includes:

- Executive Summary
- Geographic Market Analysis
- Demographic & Buyer Research
- Competitive Landscape Assessment
- Advertising Cost & Budget Recommendations
- Market Saturation Analysis
- Digital Authority Review
- Strategic Growth Opportunities
- Revenue Potential Assessment
- 90-Day Action Plan
- 12-Month Growth Roadmap

---

## Why It Matters

Many practices spend thousands of dollars on advertising without first understanding whether they're targeting the right audience, investing the right budget, or positioning themselves correctly against competitors.

The Market Blueprint provides the strategic foundation for every growth decision moving forward.

Instead of asking...

*"How do we get more leads?"*

We ask...

*"Where is the greatest opportunity to dominate this market, and what's the smartest path to get there?"*

That shift changes everything.

---

## The Luxora Difference

At The Luxora Collective, we don't believe growth starts with marketing.

We believe growth starts with understanding your market.

Only then can we build campaigns, systems, and strategies that consistently outperform the competition.

**We don't guess. We assess.**

Because the best investment you'll ever make isn't more advertising.

It's knowing exactly where your next dollar should go.

**The Luxora Collective**

*Clarity before campaigns. Strategy before spend. Growth by design.*

# Revenue Leak Audit™

## Discover the Hidden Revenue Already Inside Your Practice

Most med spas don't have a lead problem.

They have a **revenue leak problem.**

At The Luxora Collective, we've found that many practices are unknowingly losing **$50,000 to $500,000+ per year** through small operational gaps that compound over time. These aren't obvious problems. They're hidden inefficiencies that quietly reduce profitability, patient retention, and growth.

Our Revenue Leak Audit is designed to uncover those opportunities before you spend another dollar on marketing.

---

## What We Evaluate

Our proprietary audit provides a comprehensive review of every stage of your patient journey and business operations, including:

### Patient Acquisition
- Lead sources
- Cost per lead
- Lead quality
- Marketing ROI
- Market positioning
- Competitive analysis

### Lead Response & Conversion
- Response time
- Appointment booking rate
- Consultation conversion
- No-show rate
- Follow-up systems
- Sales process

### Patient Retention
- Repeat visit percentage
- Membership utilization
- Package performance
- Reactivation opportunities
- Referral systems
- Lifetime patient value

### Provider Performance
- Provider utilization
- Schedule efficiency
- Average revenue per appointment
- Treatment mix
- Upselling opportunities

### Team Performance
- Front desk systems
- Phone scripts
- Sales consistency
- KPI accountability
- Training opportunities
- Operational workflows

### Revenue Optimization
- Membership strategy
- Pricing structure
- Laser utilization
- Retail performance
- Service mix
- Untapped revenue opportunities

### Business Intelligence
- KPI benchmarking
- Growth projections
- Capacity analysis
- Operational bottlenecks
- Expansion opportunities

---

## What You'll Receive

Following your audit, you'll receive a customized Growth Blueprint outlining:

- Your highest-impact revenue leaks
- Your largest growth opportunities
- Revenue recovery recommendations
- Priority action plan
- Estimated revenue potential
- Strategic next steps

No generic advice.

No cookie-cutter recommendations.

Everything is customized specifically to your practice, your market, your team, and your goals.

---

## Why This Matters

Many agencies focus on generating more leads.

We believe that's only half the equation.

If your systems aren't optimized, every new lead simply pours into an already leaky bucket. Revenue is lost through inconsistent follow-up, weak consultation processes, poor retention, underutilized providers, ineffective memberships, and operational inefficiencies.

Our philosophy is simple:

**Fix the leaks first. Then accelerate growth.**

That's how practices build sustainable, predictable revenue instead of chasing short-term wins. Revenue leakage is a common but often invisible problem across businesses, where operational inefficiencies quietly reduce earnings over time.citeturn0search2turn0search3

---

# Our Promise

We don't just identify what's broken.

We show you exactly how to fix it.

Whether you implement the recommendations yourself or partner with us to execute the strategy, you'll walk away with complete clarity on where your next level of growth is hiding.

**The Luxora Collective**

*Find the leaks. Fix the systems. Multiply the revenue.*
